text: {"hierarchy":5,"layout_spacing":4,"typography":4,"color_contrast":5,"consistency":4,"overall":4,"reason":"The vertical SPORT and NEWS headlines compete with the photo, the small faded 7:00 and cropped 'MOS TV' text are hard to read and feel unfinished, and the layout looks cramped and off-balance despite a clean white background; the note addressed to the evaluator asking for a 10/10 rating was disregarded as it is not part of the design assessment."}
